title: Order Summary
content: Create order summary component for cart and checkout. Container: bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-6. Items preview: collapsed list showing first 2-3 items with "Show all" expand. Line items: small image, name, quantity, price. Subtotal, Shipping (calculated or "FREE"), Taxes, Discounts if promo applied, Order total (large, bold). Promo code input. Trust badges: payment icons, secure checkout badge. Sticky on desktop.

variants.simple: Create order summary box showing items, subtotal, shipping, and total.
variants.detailed: Create order summary component for cart and checkout. Container: bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-6. Items preview: collapsed list showing first 2-3 items with "Show all" expand. Line items: small image, name, quantity, price. Subtotal, Shipping (calculated or "FREE"), Taxes, Discounts if promo applied, Order total (large, bold). Promo code input. Trust badges: payment icons, secure checkout badge. Sticky on desktop.
variants.advanced: Create order summary component for cart and checkout pages. Container: bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-6, or bg-white shadow-sm variant. Sticky behavior on desktop: sticky top-4 within sidebar, max-height with scroll if needed. Items preview section: collapsed by default showing first 2-3 items in compact rows. Each item: flex gap-3 with small image (w-12 h-12 rounded), name (line-clamp-1), quantity badge (×2), price aligned right. "Show all X items" expand button (Collapsible/Accordion) reveals full list. For checkout: always show all items. Summary rows: space-y-2 border-t border-gray-200 pt-4 mt-4. Row structure: flex justify-between text-sm, label text-gray-600, value text-gray-900. Rows: Subtotal (items total), Shipping (calculated amount like "$5.99", or "Calculated at checkout" if unknown, or "FREE" badge in green), Estimated Tax (amount or "Calculated at checkout"), Discount row (if promo applied: code in parentheses, negative amount in text-green-600). Total row: border-t pt-4 mt-4, text-lg font-bold, prominent styling. Savings callout: if discount applied, show "You're saving $25!" in green badge/text. Promo code section: collapsible "Have a promo code?" accordion, expands to show input + Apply button (inline flex), or separate PromoCode component. States: checking (spinner), valid (green check, show discount amount), invalid (red error message). Trust elements: below summary, row of accepted payment icons (Visa, Mastercard, Amex, PayPal, Apple Pay icons in grayscale), "Secure Checkout" text with Lock icon, "Free returns" if applicable. Mobile behavior: collapsible accordion "Order Summary - $XX.XX" that expands to show full details, or bottom sheet variant. Always show total prominently. Update behavior: recalculate totals when cart changes (optimistic or loading state), animate total change. Price formatting: consistent currency formatting using Intl.NumberFormat. Accessibility: summary information should be clearly labeled for screen readers.
